segments.ja313:1.1: Yo te hatthe ca pāde ca, kaṇṇanāsañca chedayi;
segments.ja313:1.3: Tassa kujjha mahāvīra, mā raṭṭhaṃ vinasā [vinassa (ka. sī. syā. ka.)] idaṃ.
segments.ja313:2.1: Yo me hatthe ca pāde ca, kaṇṇanāsañca chedayi;
segments.ja313:2.3: Ciraṃ jīvatu so rājā, na hi kujjhanti mādisā.
segments.ja313:3.1: Ahū atītamaddhānaṃ [ahu atītamaddhāne (syā. pī. ka.)], samaṇo khantidīpano;
segments.ja313:4.1: Tassa kamma [kammassa (sī. pī.)] pharusassa, vipāko kaṭuko ahu;
